title: First-face extra degeneracy gives a section and combinatorial simplicial homotopy
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be any category, and use the simplex category of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. For maps $f,g:A_\bullet\to B_\bullet$ of simplicial objects, a combinatorial simplicial homotopy from $f$ to $g$ means maps $H_j^n:A_n\to B_{n+1}$ for $n\geq0$ and $0\leq j\leq n$ satisfying
$$d_0H_0^n=g_n,\qquad d_{n+1}H_n^n=f_n,$$
$$d_iH_j^n=H_{j-1}^{n-1}d_i\ (i<j),\qquad d_{j+1}H_{j+1}^n=d_{j+1}H_j^n\ (j<n),\qquad d_iH_j^n=H_j^{n-1}d_{i-1}\ (i>j+1),$$
$$s_iH_j^n=H_{j+1}^{n+1}s_i\ (i\leq j),\qquad s_iH_j^n=H_j^{n+1}s_{i-1}\ (i>j),$$
whenever all indices are defined. Let $Z_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ have an augmentation $e:Z_\bullet\to\operatorname{const}Y$. Suppose maps $h_{-1}:Y\to Z_0$ and $h_n:Z_n\to Z_{n+1}$ satisfy
$$e_0h_{-1}=1_Y,\qquad d_0h_n=1_{Z_n},\qquad d_1h_0=h_{-1}e_0,$$
$$d_{i+1}h_{n+1}=h_nd_i\ (0\leq i\leq n+1),\qquad s_{i+1}h_n=h_{n+1}s_i\ (0\leq i\leq n).$$
Then $a_n=Z(q_n)h_{-1}$, where $q_n:[n]\to[0]$ is the unique map, defines a simplicial section $a:\operatorname{const}Y\to Z_\bullet$ with $ea=1$, and there is a combinatorial simplicial homotopy from $ae$ to $1_{Z_\bullet}$.
